question: Which divine forms preside at Madrapīṭha and at Mātaṅga?
premises: Madrapīṭhe names the first sacred site.
Gangādharo is the presiding form there.
Mātaṅge names the second sacred site.
Tryambakaḥ is the presiding form there.
inference: The Gaṅgā-bearer presides at Madrapīṭha and the three-eyed one presides at Mātaṅga.
plain_english: At Madrapīṭha is the Gaṅgā-bearer, and at Mātaṅga is the three-eyed one.
